pages.title: About
pages.markdown:
## Our story

Your Brand was founded in 1998 to give large organizations a single, dependable system to run on. Twenty-six years later, more than nine hundred of the world’s largest companies use it to move money, goods and information across borders.

## How we work

We make long commitments: to customers, to employees and to the places we operate. Every product ships with a published roadmap, a support window measured in years and a named owner.

## Where we are going

The next decade is about making critical infrastructure quieter: fewer incidents, less energy and nothing a customer has to think about on a Monday morning.
